title.narrative: Number of advances or defences that focus on or affect a specific vulnerable population are achieved in legislation/policy.

target.value: At least one step is taken in focus countries towards greater accountability for abuses, such as indictments or legal judgments sanctioning abuse.

actual.value: 1 advance that focus on or affect a specific vulnerable population were achieved in legislation/policy (2020), 8 high-impact pieces of media attention on the special vulnerability of children/women/migrants/minorities to torture and ill treatment were published in national and/or international media (2020), 1 steps taken in focus countries towards greater accountability for abuses, such as indictments or legal judgments sanctioning abuse (2020) (Philippines).

target.value: At least two advances or defences that focus on or affect a specific vulnerable population are achieved in legislation/policy.

actual.value: 2 advances or defences that focus on or affect a specific vulnerable population were achieved in legislation/policy (2019) (Togo, Philippines), 2 high-impact pieces of media attention on the special vulnerability of children to torture and ill treatment published in national and/or international media (2019) (Philippines, Brazil), 0 steps taken in focus countries towards greater accountability for abuses, such as indictments or legal judgments sanctioning abuse (2019).

title.narrative: The number, capacity, engagement, and level of cooperation of local civil society anti-torture actors around the world has increased and strengthened, achieving progress toward targeted results through engagement with the OMCT in focus.

Greater compliance with the UN Convention Against Torture in focus countries, demonstrated through achievement of country- and/or regional/international targeted results toward the project objectives during the period.

target.value: Engagement with 150 OMCT members and partners in their fight against torture in eighty countries.

actual.value: Five new Network Members joined in 2020 and OMCT has engaged actively with 118 OMCT members and partners in their fight against torture in 87 countries.
